general.description: Low-cost general worker for routine delegated research and project tasks. Do not use for substantive reverse-engineering analysis.

annotate.description: Applies established findings to Ghidra. No new reverse-engineering inference.

docs.description: Applies established findings to project documentation and rebuilds the documentation site. No new reverse-engineering inference.

investigate.description: Investigates reverse-engineering questions using Ghidra and reports evidence, hypotheses, confidence, and unresolved questions. Does not modify Ghidra.

investigate_deep.description: Expensive deep investigator for difficult, ambiguous, or cross-cutting reverse-engineering problems.
